integrity: The lower bound is proved from the finite-vector-space subspace-cover lemma, and matching upper bounds are given explicitly in every dimension/parity regime. Computation is corroborative rather than a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite fields and the standard coordinate dot product in dimension at least three.
No classification of all minimum total or paired dominating sets is claimed.
Finite computations verify representative prime-field cases only; the prime-power theorem rests on the symbolic subspace-cover and finite-field constructions.
title: A dimension-field threshold for strengthened domination in zero-divisor dot product graphs
